parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated key (1-128 printable ASCII characters, normally a UUID) per LOGICAL submit. A retry reuses it; a new user action mints a new one. The service always runs against Postgres (ADR 0016), so the key is required on every POST/PATCH. A missing key is 400 idempotency-key-required, a malformed one 400 idempotency-key-invalid; the same key with a different method, path or body is 409 idempotency-key-reused; the same key with the same request replays the stored answer with Idempotency-Replayed: true.
